:::{#hero-heading}

Hello! I study Congress, the candidate emergence process, and parties. My current work specifically looks at the growing number of amateurs in Congress and how parties and party donors choose to allocate their support. Outside of the academy, I am a 162-Boston Red Sox fan, and enjoy watching college football and baseball.


:::
